name: b6724-ripple
negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, text, watermark, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, fused fingers
prompt: A slow ripple spreads across the dark well water and bends the reflected clouds out of shape, then the water calms and the reflection becomes clear again. Self-deception and reflection - a quiet inner voice that twists what you see, then clarity. Static camera looking down. Keep every object exactly as in the image, nothing added or removed. No faces, no hands, no blood, no creatures, no moon, no text.
